title: Alpha One — event Suspended v1
description: V1 catalog event `Suspended` (v1). Envelope per EVT-03 (see envelope.schema.json). Producer/consumers per contracts/events/catalog.md: consumers = PAY-04 (payout hold — status check at request/approval time, not event consumption; docs/11 §3.1/§3.7, D39), ANA-01. Derived from: docs/07 §3.2 (ACTIVE/FUNDED→SUSPENDED rows: 'BRG-14 disable trading; Suspended (LCC-23); payouts blocked (PAY-04)'); actor per docs/32 `account_state_history` (actor_kind/actor_id); docs/14 §3.4: no V1 email (deliberate, D61 closed set). Money is integer minor units (docs/00 #3); the envelope carries tenant_id — no redundant tenant field in the payload.
